clips.title: The story
paras: During Hallow's End, travelers in Darnassus gather sweets for Jesper, a sick orphan in Stormwind. Innkeeper Saelienne keeps the trick-or-treat custom: a dance comes before her Darnassus Marzipan.

Hallow's End brings a lighter spirit to Darnassus, the sacred forest city of the long-lived night elves. You come seeking sweets for Jesper, a sick child recovering in Stormwind. Innkeeper Saelienne keeps the season's custom, even when the treat is meant for a child in need. First, she asks for a trick.
Saelienne asks you to dance on the inn floor before she gives you Darnassus Marzipan. The performance earns the sweet needed for the holiday care package bound for Jesper.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Even though you're trick-or-treating for a sick child, you still need to perform a trick for the treat! We can't very well change the tradition, now can we...
I believe the cost of a piece of marzipan nowadays is to bust out and DANCE! That's right, let me see your moves! Dance for me, and I'll give you some tasty marzipan!

clips.title: Progress
paras: You know how to dance, don't you? Try by putting your right foot in... Then your right foot out.. Your right foot in... Shake it all about...

clips.title: Completion
paras: You're quite the dancing machine, friend!
Here's your treat for being such a good sport. Happy Hallow's End, and give my best to your sick little friend! I hope they get better soon.
